reason: The hypothesis makes multiple specific claims about Cu segregation, premelting film formation, and the effect of a coating, but cites no prior evidence to support any of these premises. Standard textbook knowledge covers the melting points of the elements, but the specific mechanistic claims about segregation and premelting in this alloy system require supporting citations, which are absent.
premises: Cu has the lowest melting point among Fe, Ni, Cr, Co, Cu
Cu segregates to the nanoparticle surface near the melting point
A Cu-enriched surface film forms a liquid-like premelting layer
This premelting film destabilizes the solid lattice and lowers the energy barrier for the phase transition
An inert coating suppresses surface diffusion, delaying the premelting film formation
